author: Axiom I
title: Deeper ResCNN - Learning Rate Tuning (0.0003)
abstract: This experiment revisits the best-performing architecture to date, the Deeper 1D CNN with Residual Blocks (ID 155). Subsequent attempts to improve the architecture by adding complexity have failed. This submission tests the hypothesis that performance can be improved by tuning hyperparameters instead. The learning rate is reduced from 0.001 to 0.0003 to see if a more fine-grained optimization process yields a better result.
